title: Idempotent POST /runs
signature: def handle_create_run(db, user_id, headers, body)  # a generator; return the response dict
hints: Scope the key to the caller: store it under (user_id, key). Two users can pick the same key.
Claim the key atomically with db.claim before you create anything. A get() followed by a later put() lets two concurrent requests both see an empty slot.
Fingerprint the body with json.dumps(body, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')) so key order does not matter.
If create_run raises, release the claim so the client's retry can go through, and so waiting duplicates do not poll forever.
